content:
The default calendar in Thunderbird is named "Home". It seems to me that before creating a CalDav calendar in Thunderbird (TB) with your iCloud "Home" calendar you had already used the Thunderbird "Home" calendar to create events. I have no solution how to sync the TB "Home" calendar with your macOS calendar.

A workaround might be to merge the events of the TB Home calendar with your iCloud calendar: in TB R-click on Home calendar and choose "Export Calendar..." A Finder window will open (image): select *.ics format, choose a file name and the destination location. On your Mac open "Calendar" > File > Import > navigate and select the exported *.ics file and click "Import". A dialogue box will open and prompt you to choose a destination calendar > choose your iCloud calendar (in my image the Mac iCloud calendar is named "Personnel"). This way the events of your TB Home calendar will be merged with the events of your iCloud calendar which is already synced with Thunderbird as a CalDav calendar. If this operation is successful I advise to hide the Home calendar in TB, otherwise some events would be doubled.
